phrase.zh: 时空的一次轻颤，也能传得很远。
phrase.en: A ripple in spacetime can travel far.

visual.zh: 层层涟漪围绕两个明亮天体扩散，将难以直接看见的引力波化作水波般的形态。这不是探测器输出的波形。
visual.en: Ripples radiate from two luminous bodies, giving an invisible gravitational wave a water-like form. This is not a detector trace.

background.zh: 广义相对论预言，加速运动的大质量天体可以产生引力波。LIGO 于 2015 年首次直接探测到来自双黑洞并合的信号，开启了通过时空扰动研究宇宙的新途径。
background.en: General relativity predicts gravitational waves from accelerating massive bodies. In 2015 LIGO directly detected a signal from merging black holes, opening another way to study the universe through disturbances in spacetime.
